intro: Deep within the Royal Library of Stormwind Keep, head librarian Donyal Tovald manages a collection of historical texts and regional accounts. By order of the young King Anduin Wrynn, funds have been allocated to transcribe copies of these works for citizens and scholars who bring official library scrips. This service allows adventurers to study the history, factions, and legends of Azeroth firsthand.

clips.title: Progress
paras: King Anduin has placed great importance on learning, and thus has provided funds for making copies of various tomes and writings available to the public. It's very simple. You bring me a library scrip, and I can give you a copy of one of the available books.
